result.summary: This complex intersection features multiple streetcar tracks and overhead wires but lacks any marked pedestrian crossings or dedicated signals. The wide, unmarked expanse of pavement creates a hostile environment where pedestrians must navigate traffic without designated paths or protection.

hazards.name: Absence of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: No painted markings exist to guide pedestrians or alert drivers to crossing locations across the wide intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Across all visible legs of the intersection

hazards.name: Streetcar tracks
hazards.description: Multiple sets of embedded tracks create significant trip hazards and can be slippery for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and foreground of the intersection

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian signals
hazards.description: The intersection is signalized for vehicles but lacks any walk/don't-walk indicators for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: At the traffic light poles on the corners

interventions.title: Install High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Paint continental-style crosswalks on all legs of the intersection to define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Add Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing intervals.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to reduce crossing distances and improve sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection is a wide, multi-lane expanse lacking basic pedestrian safety features such as marked crosswalks or dedicated signals. The presence of embedded rail tracks and degraded pavement creates additional hazards for those attempting to cross.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no painted markings to designate a safe crossing area for pedestrians at this large intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Across all legs of the intersection

hazards.name: Embedded rail tracks
hazards.description: Rail tracks embedded in the asphalt can cause tripping or catch bicycle tires, especially given the poor pavement condition around them.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and center of the intersection

hazards.name: Excessive crossing distance
hazards.description: The wide expanse of the intersection increases the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicle traffic without any refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire width of the roadway

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks on all legs of the intersection to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear right-of-way information.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Islands
interventions.description: Construct raised islands in the center of the wide roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a wide, multi-lane intersection with embedded streetcar tracks and high-visibility crosswalks. While signals and sidewalks are present, the significant crossing distance and lack of a median refuge create a high-exposure environment for people walking.

hazards.name: Streetcar tracks
hazards.description: Embedded tracks in the roadway can cause tripping hazards for pedestrians and are slippery when wet.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and center of the intersection

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for a long duration without a refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Main crossing across the multi-lane road

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to provide a safe waiting area and reduce the unprotected crossing distance.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light.

result.summary: The intersection lacks essential pedestrian safety features such as marked crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and curb ramps, despite being signalized for vehicles. The presence of trolley tracks and significantly degraded pavement creates additional physical hazards for those crossing the street.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossings
hazards.description: The absence of painted crosswalks at a signalized intersection leaves pedestrians without a designated or protected path.

hazards.description: Exposed metal tracks and cracked, uneven asphalt pose significant tripping risks and hazards for mobility devices.
